meta_description:
1M likes, 2,737 comments - hegdepooja on August 17, 2026: "It was truly an honour and a matter of immense pride to be the Guest of Honour at the India Day Parade in New York. 🇮🇳

There was something incredibly surreal about seeing the streets of New York come alive with so many Indians, proudly celebrating our country and everything that connects us to home.

Thank you to @federationofindianassociations for the honour and a beautifully organised event along with the officials of New York. 

To be there, doing this with you all is a privilege I don’t take lightly. Gratitude for this moment that I’ll carry with me for a long time. ❤️ Jai Hind 🇮🇳".
